current_activity: 275th Division weak defenses at Barenton, threatening the southern flank of the Mortain attack
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 24 p. 459: that evening, 6 August, Barenton (seven miles southeast of Mortain) was being threatened and the weakness of the 275th Division's defenses at the village made obvious the menace to the southern flank; ch. 25 p. 482: the LVIII Corps, with the 10th SS Panzer Division, was later inserted at Barenton to relieve the weak 275th. Location: Barenton, named in the source. Location approximate: the division headquarters is not named; the point is the village its defenses covered, precision 10 km.
